Dadi ne poocha: "Itne saare test, sabke ek jaise hote hain?" 🩸
Dr Saathi ne kaha: nahi! Aapki sehat dekhkar test chunte hain. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Test aapki umar, bimari aur operation ke hisaab se tay hote hain
✅ Bade operation mein khoon ki jaanch (blood count) hoti hai
✅ Sugar ya kidney ki bimari ho toh unki jaanch bhi hoti hai
✅ Dil ki bimari ho toh ECG hota hai
Kaunsa test aapke liye zaroori hai, apne doctor se poochhiye.
